title: arctium neurocentrum
intro: Arctium neurocentrum, commonly known as the Burdock or Gobo, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Arctium neurocentrum are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in the treatment of various health conditions.
